title: Field Engineer
desc:
About ALTechnology
ALTechnology is an engineering company specializing in the design and integration of electronic security, audiovisual, and network infrastructure systems for high-security facilities and international projects.
About the Position
This position is ideal for an engineer with
2–4 years of experience in low-current or electronic security systems
, previous construction site experience, and the ability to independently manage a defined scope of work while continuing to develop technical and project management skills.
The role requires a willingness and ability to undertake
international assignments lasting approximately 3–5 months at a time
.
The successful candidate will be expected to:
Supervise the installation of electronic security and related infrastructure systems at project sites.
Monitor subcontractor activities and verify compliance with technical drawings, specifications, and project requirements.
Support testing, commissioning, system verification, and handover processes.
Prepare field reports, as-built records, and acceptance documentation.
Coordinate technical matters with main contractor site teams in English.
Maintain regular, structured written communication with ALTechnology's engineering office.
Identify site issues, technical deviations, and implementation risks, and follow up on corrective actions.
Use digital reporting systems and remain open to AI-assisted tools for documentation and engineering workflows.
Key Responsibilities
Site Installation Supervision & Implementation Control
Supervise installation activities for CCTV, access control, intrusion detection, perimeter security, audiovisual, and network infrastructure systems, as applicable to the assigned project.
Inspect installation work performed by subcontractors and site teams.
Verify that field implementation complies with approved drawings, technical specifications, and project standards.
Monitor installation progress, identify discrepancies, and coordinate corrective actions.
Support the resolution of technical issues encountered during site execution.
Ensure effective coordination between installation teams and project stakeholders.
Testing, Commissioning & Handover
Participate in system testing, functional verification, and commissioning activities.
Assist with troubleshooting and the resolution of installation and integration issues.
Verify system performance against project requirements and approved documentation.
Prepare and maintain testing records, commissioning reports, punch lists, and acceptance documents.
Support project handover activities and ensure that required technical records are complete.
Technical Documentation & Reporting
Prepare regular site progress reports and technical observations.
Read and interpret technical drawings and use AutoCAD drawings for site implementation checks.
Maintain accurate as-built drawings and records of field changes.
Document installation progress, technical deviations, and outstanding issues through digital reporting systems.
Ensure that site information is communicated to the engineering office in a clear, timely, and structured manner.
Follow established documentation procedures and maintain traceability throughout project execution.
Qualifications
Technical Qualifications
The ideal candidate should possess the following qualifications and experience:
Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Communications Engineering, or a closely related engineering discipline.
2–4 years of professional experience in low-current systems, electronic security systems, or related technical installation projects.
Previous construction site experience, including hands-on involvement in installation supervision or implementation control.
Ability to read and interpret technical drawings and use AutoCAD drawings for site-related checks.
Experience preparing site reports, technical records, or similar project documentation.
Technical English proficiency sufficient to communicate with contractors and project stakeholders on-site.
Willingness and ability to work at international project sites for
3–5 months per assignment
.
Ability to work with digital reporting tools and adapt to new technologies.
Professional Competencies
Strong sense of responsibility and ownership of assigned work packages.
Practical problem-solving skills and attention to technical detail.
Good planning, organization, and follow-up skills.
Clear written communication and effective coordination with multiple stakeholders.
A disciplined approach to technical documentation and reporting.
Ability to work independently within an assigned scope while collaborating with the wider engineering team.
Willingness to learn, receive feedback, and develop technical expertise.
Adaptability to international site environments and changing project requirements.
If you are an engineer with site experience, a hands-on approach, and the motivation to take ownership of technical work packages, we would be pleased to hear from you.
